author: Ate2
quote:
Boring and soulless.

I found it boring to play. That alone should justify a low rating, but on top of that, we’re talking about a AAA title riddled with errors and bugs (it crashed on me twice) that failed to deliver on its promises.

If you tell me the graphics will be incredible, I expect good physics.
If you tell me it’s an open-world game, I expect multiple endings or for the characters to engage in roleplay with me—explaining, for instance, why they might refuse to do something.
If you tell me there will be attention to detail, I expect beer cans not to just magically appear in my hand.

It’s not a good game; it’s barely playable, and it’s boring. It’s a game with plenty of detail, but no soul.

author: Ate2
quote: I wasn’t planning on voting for a game from ’98—a title every video game developer cites as a foundational inspiration—but since the *GTA* "tourists" are hanging around here...This is the game that gave us everything.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Ate2
quote: It drew me into a quest for vengeance; I felt its fury and wanted to track down all the villains—not because the missions required it, but because I wanted to make them pay.That is what I look for in a game: to truly live it.

author: Ate2
quote:
Everything a game should be: entertaining, atmospheric, and featuring a graphic design perfectly suited to the story it wants you to experience.

I am amazed by how well it blends puzzles, adventure, and combat; it was so easy to feel like a part of this world and step into the role of the protagonist myself. I can imagine hundreds of stories about my own experiences in Hyrule. I don’t know—it just makes me dream.

I understand why the original is so highly regarded; it’s where it all began. It is... perfect.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
